newsitem.title: USA: Americans warned to be careful in Kenya.
newsitem.headline: Americans warned to be careful in Kenya.

text.p: The U.S. State Department on Tuesday warned U.S. citizens travelling to Kenya to take steps to increase their security because of violence reported at recent political rallies in Nairobi and other cities.

Travelers should follow news reports to keep abreast of where and when political rallies were planned in the run-up to Kenyan national elections in late 1997 or early 1998, the department said. Rally and demonstration sites should be avoided, it said.

Hundreds of Kenyan students took to the streets of Nairobi for the second consecutive day on Tuesday, a week after nine people were killed during unrest in Nairobi and other towns and cities and fierce clashes between demonstrators and riot police.
Opposition-backed groups have campaigned since April for constitutional reforms before presidential and parliamentary elections.
"As the elections draw nearer, these rallies and demonstrations are likely to become more frequent and the potential for violence will continue," the State Department said.
U.S. citizens in Kenya were encouraged to register with the consular section of the U.S. embassy in Nairobi to get updated information on the security situation.
